+
+RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git git-lfs && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
+
+RUN git lfs install
+WORKDIR /testbed
+
+# Install system dependencies
+RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
+    git \
+    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
+
+# Copy the repository contents
+COPY . .

+
